messages.subject: conditional tags involving iterators that have decimal values?
parts:
Hi again,

I'm using iterators specified in the init file that have decimal values, for example one including these numerical values:
variable1 = 0 0.1 0.2 0.3 0.4;

And some using whole numbers, for example one with these values:
variable2 = 10 30 50 100;

In using conditional tags within the Mplus portion of the code to generate input files, I find that the whole number tags are being read just fine, including the whole number value in the first set above, but decimal values are not being interpreted. Is there a trick to fix this?

To be more concrete, this type of syntax works:

[[variable1 = 0]] [[variable2=10]] y on x@.50;
[[/variable2=10]] [[/variable1=0]]

But not this:

[[variable1 = 0.1]] [[variable2=10]] y on x@.60;
[[/variable2=10]] [[/variable1=0.1]]
